description: 4-AO analog output ioThinx 45MR slot module. Addresses are module-relative; actual PDU address = slot_base + relative_address. FC03: aoValueRaw ch0-3 (raw DAC counts, rel 0-3), aoValueScaled ch0-3 (f32 engineering-unit value, 2 regs/ch = 8 regs, rel 4-11). FC04: aoMode ch0-3 (0=disable 1=0-10V 2=0-20mA 3=4-20mA 4=±10V). Write to aoValueScaled to set output in engineering units; write to aoValueRaw for raw DAC counts.
